result.topic_en: Differential relations between the sides and angles of a spherical triangle, followed by the basic spherical trigonometry formulas (law of cosines, sine law, polar cosine law, and the four-part cotangent formula).
result.transcription:
1. $\partial a = \cos B . dc + \cos C . db + \sin b \sin C . dA$
2. $dA = -\cos b . dC - \cos c . dB + \sin b \sin C\, \partial a$
3. $\mathrm{cotg}\, a . \partial a - \mathrm{cotg}\, b . \partial b = \mathrm{cotg}\, A . \partial A - \mathrm{cotg}\, B\, d B$
4 $0 = \sin C . db - \cos C \sin b . \partial A - \cos a \sin B . \partial c - \sin a . \partial B$

(5)

1 $\cos a = \cos b \cos c + \sin b \sin c \cos A$
— $\sin a \cos B = \cos b \sin c - \sin b \cos c \cos A$
2 $\sin a \sin B = \sin b \sin A$
— $\cos a \sin B = \cos A \sin C + \sin A \cos C \cos b$
3 $\cos B = -\cos A \cos C + \sin A \sin C . \cos b$
4 $\underset{2}{\cos A} \underset{3}{\cos c} = \underset{1}{\mathrm{cotg}\, b} . \underset{3}{\sin c} - \underset{4}{\mathrm{cotg}\, B} . \underset{2}{\sin A}$

methods.what: Differential relation for side a in terms of variations of the other side/angle elements of a spherical triangle
methods.quote: $\partial a = \cos B . dc + \cos C . db + \sin b \sin C . dA$

methods.what: Polar (dual) differential relation for angle A
methods.quote: $dA = -\cos b . dC - \cos c . dB + \sin b \sin C\, \partial a$

methods.what: Differential form of the spherical sine law
methods.quote: $\mathrm{cotg}\, a . \partial a - \mathrm{cotg}\, b . \partial b = \mathrm{cotg}\, A . \partial A - \mathrm{cotg}\, B\, d B$

methods.what: Differential form of the four-part (cotangent) formula
methods.quote: $0 = \sin C . db - \cos C \sin b . \partial A - \cos a \sin B . \partial c - \sin a . \partial B$

methods.what: Spherical law of cosines for sides
methods.quote: $\cos a = \cos b \cos c + \sin b \sin c \cos A$
$\sin a \cos B = \cos b \sin c - \sin b \cos c \cos A$
$\cos a \sin B = \cos A \sin C + \sin A \cos C \cos b$

methods.what: Spherical law of cosines for angles
methods.quote: $\cos B = -\cos A \cos C + \sin A \sin C . \cos b$
$\underset{2}{\cos A} \underset{3}{\cos c} = \underset{1}{\mathrm{cotg}\, b} . \underset{3}{\sin c} - \underset{4}{\mathrm{cotg}\, B} . \underset{2}{\sin A}$
